runtime_profiles.name: Atari ST / STE / Mega ST 68000 build
runtime_profiles.notes: The shipping ST/STE binary is compiled for a bare 68000 and is explicitly described as the safe run-on-anything Atari build; a stock non-e ST is verified.

evidence.excerpt: Atari ST / STE / Mega ST — openua-atari-st-*.zip, 2 MB, colour monitor; tested on TOS 2.06, EmuTOS and TOS 1.04.
A 68000 build runs on any Atari, and a stock non-e ST is verified too.

runtime_profiles.name: Atari Falcon030 / TT030
runtime_profiles.notes: One -m68020-60 binary serves both Falcon030 and TT030; the standard target machines documented here are 68030 systems.

evidence.excerpt: Atari Falcon030 / TT030 — openua-falcon-*.zip, 4 MB, TOS 4.04 (Falcon) or 3.0x (TT). One binary serves both.
The Macintosh 68k code is retargeted to machines including the target 68020/030 family; Falcon030 and TT030 are supported backends.

runtime_profiles.name: Accelerated Atari ST / STE 020+ build
runtime_profiles.os: No extra TOS floor documented; TOS 2.06 tested
runtime_profiles.notes: On an accelerated ST/STE the Falcon/TT -m68020-60 binary detects ST hardware and selects the native ST display backend. The documentation explicitly states an 020 or better is required for this variant.

evidence.excerpt: Run the Falcon/TT zip's binary; the Falcon/TT zip is -m68020-60. Requirements are just the accelerator: an 020 or better.

runtime_profiles.name: Amiga ECS/OCS
runtime_profiles.notes: Bare-68000 ECS/OCS build; Kickstart 1.3 will not launch it. The documentation describes 7 MHz as playable, with acceleration improving comfort.

evidence.excerpt: Amiga ECS/OCS (A500+ / A600 / A2000, bare 68000) — Kickstart 2.0 or later, 2 MB; playable at 7 MHz.

runtime_profiles.name: Amiga AGA / RTG
runtime_profiles.notes: One -m68020 Amiga binary serves AGA and Picasso96/CyberGraphX RTG, selecting the display path at runtime. The hardware guide describes memory as about 4 MB, so no exact minimum RAM value is asserted here.

evidence.excerpt: Amiga AGA (A1200 / A4000) and RTG — Kickstart 3.0+, about 4 MB; one frua serves AGA and Picasso96/CyberGraphX RTG.
The codebase is already GCC -std=gnu99 -m68020 C.
